entities.summary: Christine Renea Salters, nicknamed "the Coal Miner's Daughter", is an American former professional boxer, boxing analyst, and motivational speaker. Competing from 1989–2012, she held the WBC female super welterweight title in 2009. Martin was the first female boxer elected to the Nevada Boxing Hall of Fame in 2016. She was elected to the International Boxing Hall of Fame in 2020, the first year that women were on the ballot.
